description: Na₆MgV₂(S₃O)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.96-3.29 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.87-3.29 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.39 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.29 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.39 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.71-3.34 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.44 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.70-3.30 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.48 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to five S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.71-3.35 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.44 Å. Mg is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three S and one O atom. There are two shorter (2.51 Å) and one longer (2.54 Å) Mg-S bond length. The Mg-O bond length is 1.88 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three S and one O atom. There are two shorter (2.38 Å) and one longer (2.41 Å) V-S bond length. The V-O bond length is 1.85 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to three S and one O atom. There are two shorter (2.19 Å) and one longer (2.22 Å) V-S bond length. The V-O bond length is 1.70 Å. There are six inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the second S site, S is bonded to five Na and one V atom to form distorted SNa₅V octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SNa₅V octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃V tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SNa₅MgV pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃V tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one V atom. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one V atom. In the sixth S site, S is bonded to five Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted SNa₅MgV pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SNa₅MgV pentagonal bipyramids, corners with three equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent SNa₅V octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form ONa₃V tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₅V octahedra, corners with three equivalent SNa₅MgV pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SNa₅V octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 69°. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent SNa₅V octahedra and edges with two equivalent SNa₅MgV pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-31°.
